steps.S01: Survey and level the supports; all hot work now: convert the old door to W1, seal end B, cut the AC sleeve
steps.S02: Prime the steel; lay the membrane over the treated floor; screw down the floor sheets
steps.S03: Fix the battens: one under every lining-panel joint and edge, infill at 600 mm or less
steps.S04: Services first fix: earth rod, conduits and cables in the batten cavities, pipes in the floor void; pressure-test the pipes at 10 bar before the foam
steps.S05: Spray foam between the battens, let it cure and trim it flush; fix the numbered lining panels (cut-outs already in place)
steps.S06: Stand the partition and cross-wall frames and fix the skins
steps.S07: Fit the door frame, fix the track on the lobby face and hang the sliding door
steps.S08: Cement board, membrane and tiles on the wet walls; coved vinyl floor
steps.S09: Set the shower tray, ledge and fixed screen
steps.S10: Hang the WC, the instant heater in the shower and its hand-shower rail
steps.S11: Lay the oak planks over the living area (end A to the partition); then assemble the fridge bay, hob base and sink base on their legs along the partition
steps.S12: Assemble the two wall cabinets and hang them on the steel rail, either side of the hob
steps.S13: Scribe and fix the worktop; drop in the sink and hob; plinth
steps.S14: Hang the chimney hood on the partition between the wall cabinets, 650 mm over the hob, and fix its chimney cover up to the ceiling
steps.S15: Fix the headboard to the back wall; bolt the frame; screw down the slats; slide in the storage boxes
steps.S16: Glue the leg strips; screw the top and the shelf; set the table by the bed head
steps.S17: Place the sofa; slot together the table and the two chairs
steps.S18: Scribe and pin the trims; caulk and paint
steps.S19: Second fix: unit board, devices, lights, alarms; test and certify
steps.S20: Lift and bolt the deck beams onto the corner castings; joists
steps.S21: Screw down the deck boards (5 mm gaps)
steps.S22: Bolt the guardrail posts to the deck beams
steps.S23: Fix the hardwood top rail; thread and tension the stainless cables
steps.S24: Veranda posts, ledger, polycarbonate and gutter over the front deck
steps.S25: Set the stair footings; bolt the two flights and the landing
steps.S26: Place the chairs and the side table
steps.S27: Bond the steelwork to earth; engineer's inspection before guest use
